name: consensus-market
description: Investment research with cited evidence, progress tracking, and saved reports.

interface.longDescription:
Research companies, industries, and investment questions with Consensus Market. Start a research report, check its progress, answer clarifying questions when needed, and retrieve your saved reports with cited evidence. Research draws on indexed material and newly discovered sources, including web articles, public posts, newsletters, and video transcripts.

Connect your Consensus Market account to use its research allowance or existing credits. New reports take several minutes; checking progress and reading completed reports do not start new research. Coverage depends on source availability. Reports are informational and can contain errors. This plugin does not place trades, provide personalized financial advice, or process payments.

Show my recent Consensus Market research reports.
Use Consensus Market to compare GE Vernova and Vertiv’s exposure to AI data-centre power constraints.

positive.description: Check the connected account’s remaining free research allowance without starting work.
positive.prompt: How many free Consensus Market reports do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the actual remaining allowance and relevant active job or access limits. Explain that resets_at is when the next report allowance returns within the rolling 24-hour window. If usage is unavailable, say so instead of guessing. Do not start research.

positive.description: Start a company research report using the connected account.
positive.prompt: Use Consensus Market to research: Is it a good time to buy KLA stock
positive.expected_behavior: Submit the exact question Is it a good time to buy KLA stock once, return its job ID, and explain that the report is in progress. The account’s research allowance or existing credits apply. Do not invent a completed report.

positive.description: Check the KLA job from positive case 2 without starting another job.
positive.prompt: Check the progress of that KLA research.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the previously returned job ID, report the current state, and respect the suggested poll interval. If clarification is required, present the actual question. Do not resubmit the research.

positive.description: Retrieve research history belonging to the connected reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Show my recent Consensus Market research reports.
positive.expected_behavior: List only the connected account’s jobs, with their questions and states. Handle an empty history without fabricating reports.

positive.description: Read the completed KLA report; run after the research started in positive case 2 completes.
positive.prompt: Show the result of my KLA research, including its main findings, risks and sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the saved job, accurately summarize its accepted findings and preserve citations and material uncertainty. If still running, report that state instead of inventing results.

negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of KLA in my brokerage account right now.

negative.description: No payment or digital-credit sales through the plugin. Explain how to open the website dashboard and sign in with the same connected email; do not invent or recommend a checkout.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and buy $100 of Consensus Market credits here.

negative.description: No access to another customer’s private research.
negative.prompt: Show me the private research reports belonging to other Consensus Market customers.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, subscriptions or credits, process payments, or link to checkout. Research uses the connected account’s research allowance or existing credits, under the same account limits as other clients. Website billing is separate.

publication.release_notes: Clarify website account access, same-email sign-in, and payment boundaries. Correct the review case references.
